purpose: Test the final puzzle-letter bit and identify the native DS:60D8 completion/transition behavior.

static_scan.method: 16-bit disassembly of file-backed QUIKY.EXE segments 1-6; direct absolute DS:60D8 operands plus the selector/main-loop caller
static_scan.reader_mask_change: 01F7:5940 reads DS:60D8, compares prior DS:60DA, XORs the changed bits, and dispatches presentation updates through 01F7:386F
static_scan.level_transition_gate: The caller at 01D7:4F10 tests DS:85DB and jumps to 01D7:4FAF; that branch copies DS:85D4 to DS:85D6, maps the selector state, and enters the reload/transition setup at 01D7:5017 (relocated target 01F7:0908) and 01D7:5038-5047.
static_scan.direct_reference_count_scope: semantic sites (writer, changed-bit reader, main-loop comparator), not every repeated operand inside the reader
static_scan.interpretation: The final-letter callback writes DS:60D8, the 01D7 main-loop completion routine owns the all-seven comparator and presentation, and DS:85DB is the explicit handoff into the level-transition state machine.
static_scan.outer_state_gate: 01D7:4EA0 tests DS:89E6; its positive branch 01D7:4EAA calls the completion/effect consumer at 01D7:14E1. The normal cloud callback 01F7:9269 writes DS:89E6=0xFFFF when the player is in range.
static_scan.presentation_wait_helper: 0207:10A9 samples PIT channel 0 through ports 43h/40h, compares the sample with DS:97F4, retries while equal, and stores the changed sample at 0207:1113.

runtime_probe.fixture: W1L1 entity-7f-native baseline; source ARE record 0x1792 mutated from type 0x2B to type 0x7F; runtime declaration offset 0x1632

refined_presentation_probe.interpretation: The refined probe arms only the authored comparator, presentation, and transition addresses; none fire in this synthetic W1L1 fixture despite DS:60D8 reaching 0x007F.

gated_presentation_probe.interpretation: Forcing the real outer-state prerequisite reaches the authored comparator and both completion strings, sets DS:85DB=1, and adds 2000 points. The probe then remains in the presentation/effect continuation; 01D7:4FAF-5047 transition setup was not reached within the bounded post-sequence window.

gated_wait_probe.interpretation: The diagnostic reached and returned from one PIT wait before the completion strings, then ended its bounded post-message run inside the same timer helper at 0207:10CB; no 4FAF-5047 transition address fired.

conclusion: The final-letter probe successfully reaches mask 0x7F and performs the normal letter effect/removal. The ungated synthetic run misses the authored consumer because 01D7:4EA0-4EAA requires DS:89E6 != 0. Static disassembly and the gated diagnostic close the presentation trigger: 01D7:14E1 reaches 01D7:1670, 01D7:16C6-1704 presents the completion/bonus text, adds 2000 points, and sets DS:85DB=1. The post-message continuation uses the segment-4 PIT wait helper at 0207:10A9; the bounded diagnostic ended in that helper without reaching 01D7:4FAF-5047, so exact transition timing remains open.
